Klinik Wysshölzli is a specialized psychiatric and psychotherapeutic private clinic in Oberaargau (Herzogenbuchsee, BE). Job: Chief psychologist 06/2026. Clinic Wysshölzli is a leading specialist clinic for women with dependency disorders and eating disorders and offers 37 inpatient treatment sites and two outpatient clinics. The clinic is on the hospital list of the Canton of Bern, has a performance contract with the cantonal health and welfare directorate and contracts with the health insurers. The location in Oberaargau, Canton of Bern, in a quiet location convinces with magnificent nature and proximity to Bern, Solothurn, Olten and Langenthal.
